page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a running head at the top; page number at top right; a printed ornament below the text. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Sed nos supremo Numini grates decet Egisse de victoria, Quod aeternit hostem nominis victor sui, Dextráque tutatur suos.
Ponamus, exemplo Danidis, in Deo Omnem penitus fiduciam.
Illi Deus arx inuicta, castra, moenia, Vrbs, perfugium, scutum fuit, Licet undequaque praeliorum incendia Eius flagrarent in caput:
Quamuis Idume, & Ismael latrocinans, Gebal, Amelech, Ammon, Moab, Et iunóta dines cum Philistaeis Tyros, Et Assur orbe ab vltimo, Sese sacramento in Danidem astringerent, Fœdúsque ferirent impium.
Tamen auspiciis ducisque Dei, potentiam Vires que fregit hostium Prius scelerum sternenda sunt examina: Colenda recte facta sunt:
Armanda mens erit fide, & manus prece, Et vita castis moribus:
Hæc arma militem tegunt: parantur his Honor, salus, Victoria.

page.notes: Printed verse, set as stanzas with line breaks. Words written with long s rendered as s. Several words are hard to read in the scan, notably "aeternit", "iunóta", "dines", "Vires que", "Armanda", "Danidis", "Danidem" and "Tamen"; these are transcribed as I read them, without [?] markers, and should be checked against the scan. The printed ornament below the text is not transcribed. Possible printing errors: "Danidis"/"Danidem" may be intended as David (printed Dauid).
